        Idea:
Implement Phase 3 (produces-with-inline-checks + repeat:{until/for_each} as body attributes) of the ArtAgents orchestrator V1 design per docs/orchestrator-v1-plan.md sections 5-6. Phase 3 scope: replace separate verifier substep with inline checks on produces declarations. produces becomes a dict of name -> {path, check}, where check is a callable verifier (file_nonempty, json_schema, json_file, audio_duration_min, image_dimensions, all_of). The gate runs each check after step completion or ack; failure rewinds the cursor. Sentinel-existence-only checks are REJECTED at definition time for non-trivial attested produces - define what counts as non-trivial (e.g., produces with non-empty type signature). Add repeat as an attribute on any step or body block: repeat: {until: user_approves|verifier_passes|quorum, max_iterations, on_exhaust} writes attempts to iterations/NNN/; repeat: {for_each: <input_set>} expands at runtime, per-item state under items/<item-id>/, supports partial approval via --item <id>. Phases 1 (kernel) and 2 (three step kinds) are already shipped - build on top. Do NOT implement DSL yet (Phase 4). Do NOT implement new lifecycle verbs (Phase 5). Keep additive: existing JSON manifests still work. Add focused tests for: produces with inline check rejects bad artifact and rewinds; produces sentinel-only is rejected at definition; repeat:until iterates correctly with cumulative feedback in iterations/NNN/; repeat:for_each expands runtime input set into items/<item-id>/; partial approval advances per-item state; on_exhaust escalate vs fail.

User notes and answers:
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-001 three step kinds: Task mode has exactly `code`, `attested`, and `nested` so execution, evidence, and delegation stay distinct.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-002 repeat body attributes: Iteration and fan-out are `repeat.until` and `repeat.for_each` body attributes so they apply uniformly to steps and nested bodies.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-003 plan naming: Runtime uses immutable `plan.json` instead of checklist naming because the structure is a tree with nested bodies and loops.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-004 event hash chain: `events.jsonl` uses plain `sha256(prev_hash + canonical_event_json)` with no HMAC because V1 needs an edit tripwire, not keyed tamper resistance.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-005 no index database: V1 ships without `.index.db` because file walking and grep over `events.jsonl` are adequate until measured otherwise.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-006 committed DSL: `artagents.orchestrate` Python DSL is the only committed authoring representation so source review happens in Python.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-007 generated build JSON: `<pack>/build/<orch>.json` is gitignored and root `.gitignore` excludes pack build outputs because runtime pins generated artifacts.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-008 per-project CAS: V1 uses only per-project `<slug>/.cas/<sha256>` storage because shared CAS adds coordination without current need.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-009 code boundary: `code` is deterministic argv, a strict superset of `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}`, may target `artagents executors run <name>`, and must not target `artagents orchestrators run`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-010 nested boundary: Sub-orchestrator delegation is exclusively `nested` so the gate can hash and pin child structure.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-011 gate checks: The gate validates active run presence, plan hash, event chain, and incoming command match before dispatch and prints the exact recovery command on rejection.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-012 gate ordering: The gate runs before `_prepare_project_request()` and `thread_wrapper.begin_orchestrator_run()` so rejected commands create zero project-run side effects.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-013 provenance surface: `events.jsonl` is the single write surface for task-mode provenance while thread provenance remains in `runs/<id>/run.json`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-014 lifecycle dispatch: Task-mode lifecycle verbs extend `artagents/pipeline.py:15` and the existing `artagents orchestrators` CLI remains unchanged.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-015 task kernel namespace: New kernel modules live in `artagents/core/task/` to isolate gate, events, active-run, and env logic from legacy runners.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-016 structure guardrails: `TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS` adds `orchestrate` and `verify`, with `tests/test_doctor_setup.py` updated so doctor accepts the new packages.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-017 task run env: `ARTAGENTS_TASK_RUN_ID` is the integration surface for orchestrator, executor, and hype child calls to attach to the parent task run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-018 child output preservation: Task mode preserves child output dirs and mirrors hype artifacts under `runs/<task-run-id>/steps/<step-id>/produces/` while standalone behavior stays unchanged so `tests/test_project_runs.py` keeps passing.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-019 attestor identity: Agent attestations require `--agent`, human attestations require `--actor` matching `ARTAGENTS_ACTOR`, and self-acks are rejected.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-020 ack rules: `approve` advances, `retry` is only valid after verifier failure, `iterate --feedback` is only valid for `repeat.until=user_approves`, and `abort` ends the run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-021 inline produces checks: Produces inline checks replace verifier substeps while `passes_test` remains a normal `code` step.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-022 semantic checks: `author check` rejects sentinel-only attested outputs because non-trivial artifacts need semantic validation.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-023 stop-hook preamble: Every `artagents next` output includes the prohibition preamble verbatim because repeated injection fights context decay.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-024 additive migration: Existing `OrchestratorDefinition` JSON manifests and `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}` keep working because V1 migration is additive.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-025 honor model: V1 is single-host and honor-based with strong logging because it does not defend against malicious local agents.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-026 cut points: Phase 3 is the frozen-plan runner ship point and Phase 5 is the author-friendly lifecycle ship point.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-027 canonical migration: `artagents/packs/builtin/hype/` is the canonical migration example because it exercises the existing executor pipeline and additive pack layout.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-028 phasing order: V1 implementation follows build phases 1-9 so kernel, step semantics, authoring, lifecycle, nudge, CAS, inbox, and golden tests land in dependency order.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-029 V1 infrastructure limits: V1 excludes daemon, web server, HMAC/keyed crypto, `.index.db`, and shared CAS so the implementation stays file-based, inspectable, and additive.

272	        seen: set[str] = set()
273	        for step in steps:

276	                raise TaskPlanError(

2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import errno
6	import hashlib
7	import json
8	import os
9	from datetime import UTC, datetime
10	from pathlib import Path
11	from typing import Any
12	
13	ZERO_HASH = "sha256:" + "0" * 64
14	
15	
16	class EventLogError(RuntimeError):
17	    """Raised when a task event log cannot be read or written."""
18	
19	
20	def canonical_event_json(event: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
21	    payload = {key: value for key, value in event.items() if key != "hash"}
22	    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
23	
24	
25	def append_event(path: str | Path, event: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
26	    events_path = Path(path)
27	    ok, _last_index, error = verify_chain(events_path)
28	    if not ok:
29	        raise EventLogError(error or f"invalid event hash chain in {events_path}")
30	
31	    previous_events = read_events(events_path)
32	    prev_hash = previous_events[-1]["hash"] if previous_events else ZERO_HASH
33	
34	    stored = dict(event)
35	    stored.pop("hash", None)
36	    stored["hash"] = _event_hash(prev_hash, stored)
37	
38	    events_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
39	    created = not events_path.exists()
40	    try:
41	        with events_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
42	            handle.write(json.dumps(stored, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False))
43	            handle.write("\n")
44	            handle.flush()
45	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
46	        if created:
47	            _fsync_dir(events_path.parent)
48	    except OSError as exc:
49	        raise EventLogError(f"failed to append event to {events_path}: {exc}") from exc
50	    return stored
51	
52	
53	def verify_chain(path: str | Path) -> tuple[bool, int, str | None]:
54	    events_path = Path(path)
55	    try:
56	        handle = events_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8")
57	    except FileNotFoundError:
58	        return True, -1, None
59	    except OSError as exc:
60	        return False, -1, f"failed to read {events_path}: {exc}"
61	
62	    prev_hash = ZERO_HASH
63	    last_index = -1
64	    with handle:
65	        for index, line in enumerate(handle):
66	            if not line.endswith("\n"):
67	                return False, index, f"event log line {index + 1} is not newline-terminated"
68	            raw = line[:-1]
69	            if not raw:
70	                return False, index, f"event log line {index + 1} is empty"
71	            try:
72	                event = json.loads(raw)
73	            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
74	                return False, index, f"invalid JSON on event log line {index + 1}: {exc.msg}"
75	            if not isinstance(event, dict):
76	                return False, index, f"event log line {index + 1} is not an object"
77	            stored_hash = event.get("hash")
78	            if not isinstance(stored_hash, str):
79	                return False, index, f"event log line {index + 1} is missing hash"
80	            expected_hash = _event_hash(prev_hash, event)
81	            if stored_hash != expected_hash:
82	                return (
83	                    False,
84	                    index,
85	                    f"event log line {index + 1} hash mismatch: expected {expected_hash}, got {stored_hash}",
86	                )
87	            prev_hash = stored_hash
88	            last_index = index
89	    return True, last_index, None
90

92	def read_events(path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
93	    events_path = Path(path)
94	    try:
95	        with events_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
96	            return [json.loads(line) for line in handle]
97	    except FileNotFoundError:
98	        return []
99	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
100	        raise EventLogError(f"invalid JSON in {events_path}: {exc.msg}") from exc
101	    except OSError as exc:
102	        raise EventLogError(f"failed to read {events_path}: {exc}") from exc

174	def _event_hash(prev_hash: str, event: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
175	    digest = hashlib.sha256((prev_hash + canonical_event_json(event)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
176	    return f"sha256:{digest}"
177	
178	
179	def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
180	    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
181	
182	
183	def _fsync_dir(path: Path) -> None:
184	    flags = getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0) | os.O_RDONLY
185	    fd: int | None = None
186	    try:
187	        fd = os.open(path, flags)
188	        os.fsync(fd)
189	    except OSError as exc:
190	        if exc.errno not in {errno.EINVAL, errno.ENOTSUP, errno.EBADF}:
191	            raise
192	    finally:
193	        if fd is not None:
194	            os.close(fd)

17	
18	def task_run_id_env() -> str | None:
19	    return os.environ.get(TASK_RUN_ID_ENV)
20	
21	
22	def task_step_id_env() -> str | None:
23	    return os.environ.get(TASK_STEP_ID_ENV)
24	
25	
26	def task_actor_env() -> str | None:
27	    return os.environ.get(ARTAGENTS_ACTOR)

30	def is_in_task_run(slug: str | None = None) -> bool:
31	    run_id = task_run_id_env()
32	    if not run_id:
33	        return False
34	    return slug is None or task_project_env() == slug
35	
36	
37	def apply_task_run_env(run_id: str, project_slug: str, step_id: str) -> None:
38	    os.environ[TASK_RUN_ID_ENV] = run_id
39	    os.environ[TASK_PROJECT_ENV] = project_slug
40	    os.environ[TASK_STEP_ID_ENV] = step_id
41	
42	
43	def child_subprocess_env(*, base: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
44	    env = dict(os.environ if base is None else base)
45	    env.pop(ARTAGENTS_ACTOR, None)
46	    for key in (TASK_RUN_ID_ENV, TASK_PROJECT_ENV, TASK_STEP_ID_ENV):
47	        value = os.environ.get(key)
48	        if value is not None:
49	            env[key] = value
50	    return env

41	@dataclass(frozen=True)

50	def validate_repo_structure(root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT) -> StructureReport:
51	    repo_root = Path(root)
52	    errors: list[str] = []
53	    errors.extend(_validate_legacy_dirs(repo_root))
54	    errors.extend(_validate_local_state_dirs(repo_root))

58	    errors.extend(_validate_pack_element_folders(repo_root / "artagents" / "packs"))
59	    return StructureReport(errors=tuple(errors))

62	def _validate_legacy_dirs(repo_root: Path) -> list[str]:
63	    errors: list[str] = []
64	    for dirname in LEGACY_PUBLIC_DIRS:
65	        candidate = repo_root / "artagents" / dirname
66	        if candidate.exists():
67	            errors.append(f"legacy public package must not exist: {candidate.relative_to(repo_root)}")
68	    return errors
69	
70	
71	def _validate_local_state_dirs(repo_root: Path) -> list[str]:
72	    errors: list[str] = []
73	    local_root = repo_root / ".artagents"
74	    if not local_root.exists():
75	        return errors
76	    for dirname in LEGACY_LOCAL_DIRS:
77	        candidate = local_root / dirname
78	        if candidate.exists():
79	            errors.append(f"legacy local state directory must not exist: {candidate.relative_to(repo_root)}")
80	    return errors
81	
82	
83	def _validate_top_level_artagents(package_root: Path) -> list[str]:
84	    errors: list[str] = []
85	    for child in sorted(package_root.iterdir()):
86	        if child.name.startswith("."):
87	            continue
88	        if child.is_file() and child.suffix == ".py" and child.name not in TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_FILES:
89	            errors.append(f"top-level artagents module must move to a canonical package: {child.relative_to(package_root.parents[0])}")
90	        if child.is_dir() and child.name not in TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS:
91	            errors.append(f"top-level artagents directory is not a canonical concept: {child.relative_to(package_root.parents[0])}")
92	    return errors
93	
94	
95	def _validate_pack_executor_folders(packs_root: Path) -> list[str]:
96	    if not packs_root.is_dir():
97	        return [f"missing packs directory: {packs_root}"]
98	
99	    errors: list[str] = []
100	    repo_root = packs_root.parents[1]
101	    for pack_dir in _public_child_dirs(packs_root, INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS):
102	        for folder in _public_child_dirs(pack_dir, INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS):
103	            if not _has_any(folder, ("executor.yaml", "executor.yml", "executor.json", "executor.py")):
104	                continue
105	            errors.extend(_require_files(folder, ("executor.yaml", "run.py", "STAGE.md"), root=repo_root))
106	            if _has_any(folder, ("orchestrator.yaml", "orchestrator.yml", "orchestrator.json", "orchestrator.py")):
107	                errors.append(f"executor folder contains orchestrator metadata: {folder.relative_to(repo_root)}")
108	            try:
109	                definitions = load_folder_executors(folder)
110	            except Exception as exc:
111	                errors.append(f"invalid executor folder {folder.relative_to(repo_root)}: {exc}")
112	                continue
113	            if not definitions:
114	                errors.append(f"executor folder emitted no executor metadata: {folder.relative_to(repo_root)}")
115	                continue
116	            for definition in definitions:
117	                pack_segment = definition.id.split(".", 1)[0]
118	                if pack_segment != pack_dir.name:
119	                    errors.append(
120	                        f"executor {definition.id!r} must live in pack {pack_segment!r} but was found in pack {pack_dir.name!r}"
121	                    )
122	    return errors

129	    errors: list[str] = []

133	            if not _has_any(folder, ("orchestrator.yaml", "orchestrator.yml", "orchestrator.json", "orchestrator.py")):
134	                continue
135	            errors.extend(_require_files(folder, ("orchestrator.yaml", "run.py", "STAGE.md"), root=repo_root))
136	            if _has_any(folder, ("executor.yaml", "executor.yml", "executor.json", "executor.py")):
137	                errors.append(f"orchestrator folder contains executor metadata: {folder.relative_to(repo_root)}")
138	            try:
139	                definitions = load_folder_orchestrators(folder)
140	            except Exception as exc:
141	                errors.append(f"invalid orchestrator folder {folder.relative_to(repo_root)}: {exc}")
142	                continue
143	            if not definitions:
144	                errors.append(f"orchestrator folder emitted no orchestrator metadata: {folder.relative_to(repo_root)}")
145	                continue
146	            for definition in definitions:

148	                if pack_segment != pack_dir.name:
149	                    errors.append(
150	                        f"orchestrator {definition.id!r} must live in pack {pack_segment!r} but was found in pack {pack_dir.name!r}"

153	
154	
155	_ELEMENT_KINDS = ("effects", "animations", "transitions")
156	
157	
158	def _validate_pack_element_folders(packs_root: Path) -> list[str]:
159	    if not packs_root.is_dir():
160	        return []
161	
162	    errors: list[str] = []
163	    repo_root = packs_root.parents[1]
164	    for pack_dir in _public_child_dirs(packs_root, INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS):
165	        elements_root = pack_dir / "elements"
166	        if not elements_root.is_dir():
167	            continue
168	        for kind_dir in _public_child_dirs(elements_root, INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS):
169	            if kind_dir.name not in _ELEMENT_KINDS:
170	                errors.append(
171	                    f"unexpected element kind folder {kind_dir.relative_to(repo_root)}: must be one of {list(_ELEMENT_KINDS)}"
172	                )
173	                continue
174	            for element_dir in _public_child_dirs(kind_dir, INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS):
175	                errors.extend(_require_files(element_dir, ("component.tsx", "element.yaml"), root=repo_root))
176	    return errors
177	
178	
179	def _public_child_dirs(root: Path, skipped: set[str]) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
180	    return tuple(sorted(path for path in root.iterdir() if path.is_dir() and path.name not in skipped and not path.name.startswith(".")))
181	
182	
183	def _require_files(folder: Path, filenames: tuple[str, ...], *, root: Path) -> list[str]:
184	    return [f"{folder.relative_to(root)} missing {filename}" for filename in filenames if not (folder / filename).is_file()]
185	
186	
187	def _has_any(folder: Path, filenames: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
188	    return any((folder / filename).exists() for filename in filenames)
189	
190	
191	__all__ = ["StructureReport", "validate_repo_structure"]

95	def derive_cursor(plan: TaskPlan, events: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> CursorPath:

98	    Reconstructible from events alone (supports partial-replay resume):

100	    ``step_completed`` / ``step_attested`` advance the top frame,
101	    ``step_dispatched`` and ``run_started`` do not advance.
102	    """
103	    frames: list[_Frame] = [_Frame(plan=plan, path_prefix=(), child_index=0)]
104	    for event in events:
105	        kind = event.get("kind")
106	        if kind == "nested_entered":
107	            top = frames[-1]
108	            if top.child_index >= len(top.plan.steps):
109	                raise TaskRunGateError(
110	                    reason="nested_entered points past end of frame",
111	                    recovery="inspect events.jsonl",
112	                )
113	            step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
114	            if not isinstance(step, NestedStep):
115	                raise TaskRunGateError(
116	                    reason="nested_entered did not land on a NestedStep",
117	                    recovery="inspect events.jsonl",
118	                )
119	            frames.append(
120	                _Frame(
121	                    plan=step.plan,
122	                    path_prefix=top.path_prefix + (step.id,),

124	                )
125	            )
126	        elif kind == "nested_exited":
127	            if len(frames) <= 1:
128	                raise TaskRunGateError(

131	                )

134	        elif kind in ("step_completed", "step_attested"):
135	            frames[-1].child_index += 1

137	    return CursorPath(frames=frames)

302	def match_attested_command(incoming: str, expected_prefix: str) -> tuple[bool, AttestedArgs]:
303	    """Strip ``--agent``/``--actor``/``--evidence`` (repeatable) tokens from
304	    ``incoming`` and compare the canonical remainder to ``expected_prefix``.
305	    """
306	    try:
307	        tokens = shlex.split(incoming)
308	    except ValueError:
309	        return False, AttestedArgs(agent=None, actor=None, evidence=())
310	    agent: str | None = None
311	    actor: str | None = None
312	    evidence: list[str] = []
313	    remaining: list[str] = []
314	    i = 0
315	    while i < len(tokens):
316	        token = tokens[i]
317	        if token == "--agent" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
318	            agent = tokens[i + 1]
319	            i += 2
320	            continue
321	        if token == "--actor" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
322	            actor = tokens[i + 1]
323	            i += 2
324	            continue
325	        if token == "--evidence" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
326	            evidence.append(tokens[i + 1])
327	            i += 2
328	            continue
329	        remaining.append(token)
330	        i += 1
331	    rejoined = " ".join(shlex.quote(token) for token in remaining)
332	    matched = rejoined == expected_prefix
333	    return matched, AttestedArgs(agent=agent, actor=actor, evidence=tuple(evidence))
334

336	def _validate_attested_identity(
337	    *,
338	    slug: str,
339	    step: AttestedStep,
340	    args: AttestedArgs,
341	    run_started_actor: str | None,
342	) -> tuple[str, str]:
343	    if args.agent is None and args.actor is None:
344	        _reject(slug, "attested step requires --agent or --actor", abort=False)
345	    if args.agent is not None and args.actor is not None:
346	        _reject(slug, "attested step rejects both --agent and --actor", abort=False)
347	    if step.ack.kind == "agent":
348	        if args.agent is None:
349	            _reject(slug, "attested step ack.kind=agent requires --agent", abort=False)
350	        return "agent", args.agent  # type: ignore[return-value]
351	    # ack.kind == "actor"
352	    if args.actor is None:
353	        _reject(slug, "attested step ack.kind=actor requires --actor", abort=False)
354	    if task_actor_env() != args.actor:
355	        _reject(slug, "attested --actor does not match ARTAGENTS_ACTOR env", abort=False)
356	    # FLAG-005: self-ack rejection only applies to actor attestations because agents
357	    # do not start runs in V1; an agent_id on run_started would be required to
358	    # symmetrically block agent self-acks, which is out of scope for Phase 2.
359	    if (
360	        run_started_actor is not None
361	        and run_started_actor == args.actor
362	        and task_actor_env() == args.actor
363	    ):
364	        _reject(slug, "self-ack rejected", abort=False)
365	    return "actor", args.actor  # type: ignore[return-value]

"""Path and id helpers for ArtAgents projects."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

PROJECTS_ROOT_ENV = "ARTAGENTS_PROJECTS_ROOT"
DEFAULT_PROJECTS_ROOT = Path("~/Documents/reigh-workspace/artagents-projects")

_SLUG_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$")
_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$")


class ProjectPathError(ValueError):
    """Raised when a project path component is invalid."""


def resolve_projects_root(root: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    raw = root if root is not None else os.environ.get(PROJECTS_ROOT_ENV)
    path = Path(raw) if raw else DEFAULT_PROJECTS_ROOT
    return path.expanduser().resolve()


def validate_project_slug(slug: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(slug, str) or _SLUG_RE.fullmatch(slug) is None:
        raise ProjectPathError(
            "project slug must start with a lowercase letter or digit and contain only lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'"
        )
    return slug


def validate_source_id(source_id: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(source_id, str) or _ID_RE.fullmatch(source_id) is None:
        raise ProjectPathError(
            "source id must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, '.', ':', '_' or '-'"
        )
    return source_id


def validate_placement_id(placement_id: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(placement_id, str) or _ID_RE.fullmatch(placement_id) is None:
        raise ProjectPathError(
            "placement id must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, '.', ':', '_' or '-'"
        )
    return placement_id


def validate_run_id(run_id: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or _ID_RE.fullmatch(run_id) is None:
        raise ProjectPathError(
            "run id must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, '.', ':', '_' or '-'"
        )
    return run_id


def project_dir(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return resolve_projects_root(root) / validate_project_slug(slug)


def project_json_path(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return project_dir(slug, root=root) / "project.json"


def project_timeline_path(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return project_dir(slug, root=root) / "timeline.json"


def sources_dir(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return project_dir(slug, root=root) / "sources"


def source_dir(slug: str, source_id: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return sources_dir(slug, root=root) / validate_source_id(source_id)


def source_json_path(slug: str, source_id: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return source_dir(slug, source_id, root=root) / "source.json"
```

123	    """Yield ``(path, step)`` in pre-order for every step in the plan tree."""

125	    def _walk(steps: tuple[TaskPlanStep, ...], prefix: tuple[str, ...]) -> Iterator[tuple[tuple[str, ...], TaskPlanStep]]:
126	        for step in steps:

136	    if isinstance(step, CodeStep):

142	            "command": step.command,
143	            "instructions": step.instructions,
144	            "ack": {"kind": step.ack.kind},
145	        }
146	        if step.produces:
147	            out["produces"] = list(step.produces)

149	    if isinstance(step, NestedStep):
150	        return {
151	            "id": step.id,
152	            "kind": "nested",
153	            "plan": step.plan.to_dict(),
154	        }

158	def _read_plan_payload(plan_path: str | Path) -> Any:
159	    path = Path(plan_path)
160	    try:
161	        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
162	    except FileNotFoundError:
163	        raise

166	    except OSError as exc:

170	def _validate_plan(payload: Any, *, _is_root: bool = True) -> TaskPlan:
171	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
172	        raise TaskPlanError("plan must be an object")
173	    plan_id = payload.get("plan_id")
174	    version = payload.get("version")
175	    steps = payload.get("steps")
176	    if not isinstance(plan_id, str) or not plan_id:
177	        raise TaskPlanError("plan plan_id must be a non-empty string")
178	    if version != 1 or isinstance(version, bool):
179	        raise TaskPlanError("plan version must be 1")
180	    if not isinstance(steps, list):
181	        raise TaskPlanError("plan steps must be a list")
182	
183	    validated_steps: list[TaskPlanStep] = []
184	    for index, step in enumerate(steps):
185	        validated_steps.append(_validate_step(step, index))
186	
187	    plan = TaskPlan(plan_id=plan_id, version=1, steps=tuple(validated_steps))
188	    if _is_root:
189	        _assert_unique_paths(plan)
190	    return plan

193	def _validate_step(step: Any, index: int) -> TaskPlanStep:
194	    if not isinstance(step, dict):
195	        raise TaskPlanError(f"plan steps[{index}] must be an object")
196	    kind = step.get("kind", "code")
197	    if kind == "code":
198	        return _validate_code_step(step, index)
199	    if kind == "attested":
200	        return _validate_attested_step(step, index)
201	    if kind == "nested":
202	        return _validate_nested_step(step, index)
203	    raise TaskPlanError(

205	    )

212	        raise TaskPlanError(f"plan steps[{index}].id must be a non-empty string")
213	    if not isinstance(command, str) or not command:
214	        raise TaskPlanError(f"plan steps[{index}].command must be a non-empty string")
215	    _reject_orchestrators_run(command, index)

219	def _validate_attested_step(step: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> AttestedStep:
220	    step_id = step.get("id")
221	    command = step.get("command")
222	    instructions = step.get("instructions")
223	    produces = step.get("produces", [])
224	    ack = step.get("ack")
225	    if not isinstance(step_id, str) or not step_id:
226	        raise TaskPlanError(f"plan steps[{index}].id must be a non-empty string")
227	    if not isinstance(command, str) or not command:
228	        raise TaskPlanError(f"plan steps[{index}].command must be a non-empty string")
229	    if not isinstance(instructions, str) or not instructions:
230	        raise TaskPlanError(
231	            f"plan steps[{index}].instructions must be a non-empty string for attested step"
232	        )
233	    if not isinstance(produces, list) or not all(isinstance(p, str) and p for p in produces):
234	        raise TaskPlanError(
235	            f"plan steps[{index}].produces must be a list of non-empty strings"
236	        )
237	    if not isinstance(ack, dict):
238	        raise TaskPlanError(f"plan steps[{index}].ack must be an object")
239	    ack_kind = ack.get("kind")
240	    if ack_kind not in {"agent", "actor"}:
241	        raise TaskPlanError(
242	            f"plan steps[{index}].ack.kind must be 'agent' or 'actor', got {ack_kind!r}"
243	        )
244	    return AttestedStep(
245	        id=validate_run_id(step_id),
246	        command=command,
247	        instructions=instructions,
248	        produces=tuple(produces),
249	        ack=AckRule(kind=ack_kind),
250	    )

253	def _validate_nested_step(step: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> NestedStep:
254	    step_id = step.get("id")
255	    child_plan = step.get("plan")
256	    if not isinstance(step_id, str) or not step_id:
257	        raise TaskPlanError(f"plan steps[{index}].id must be a non-empty string")
258	    if not isinstance(child_plan, dict):
259	        raise TaskPlanError(
260	            f"plan steps[{index}].plan must be a nested plan object"
261	        )
262	    nested = _validate_plan(child_plan, _is_root=False)
263	    return NestedStep(id=validate_run_id(step_id), plan=nested)

266	def _reject_orchestrators_run(command: str, index: int) -> None:
267	    try:
268	        tokens = shlex.split(command)
269	    except ValueError as exc:
270	        raise TaskPlanError(
271	            f"plan steps[{index}].command is not shell-parseable: {exc}"
272	        ) from exc
273	    tokens = _strip_artagents_prefix(tokens)
274	    if len(tokens) >= 2 and tokens[0] == "orchestrators" and tokens[1] == "run":
275	        raise TaskPlanError(
276	            "code step argv targets 'artagents orchestrators run'; use a nested step"
277	        )
278	
279	
280	def _strip_artagents_prefix(tokens: list[str]) -> list[str]:
281	    if (
282	        len(tokens) >= 3
283	        and Path(tokens[0]).name.startswith("python")
284	        and tokens[1:3] == ["-m", "artagents"]
285	    ):
286	        return tokens[3:]
287	    if tokens and Path(tokens[0]).name.endswith("artagents"):
288	        return tokens[1:]
289	    return tokens

292	def _assert_unique_paths(plan: TaskPlan) -> None:
293	    """Reject sibling-id collisions inside any one frame.
294	
295	    Identical leaf ids in different subtrees are accepted because their full paths differ.
296	    """
297	
298	    def _check(steps: tuple[TaskPlanStep, ...], prefix: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
299	        seen: set[str] = set()
300	        for step in steps:
301	            if step.id in seen:
302	                location = STEP_PATH_SEP.join(prefix + (step.id,))
303	                raise TaskPlanError(
304	                    f"duplicate step id {step.id!r} among siblings at {location!r}"
305	                )
306	            seen.add(step.id)
307	            if isinstance(step, NestedStep):
308	                _check(step.plan.steps, prefix + (step.id,))
309	
310	    _check(plan.steps, ())

User notes and answers:
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-001 three step kinds: Task mode has exactly `code`, `attested`, and `nested` so execution, evidence, and delegation stay distinct.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-002 repeat body attributes: Iteration and fan-out are `repeat.until` and `repeat.for_each` body attributes so they apply uniformly to steps and nested bodies.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-003 plan naming: Runtime uses immutable `plan.json` instead of checklist naming because the structure is a tree with nested bodies and loops.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-004 event hash chain: `events.jsonl` uses plain `sha256(prev_hash + canonical_event_json)` with no HMAC because V1 needs an edit tripwire, not keyed tamper resistance.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-005 no index database: V1 ships without `.index.db` because file walking and grep over `events.jsonl` are adequate until measured otherwise.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-006 committed DSL: `artagents.orchestrate` Python DSL is the only committed authoring representation so source review happens in Python.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-007 generated build JSON: `<pack>/build/<orch>.json` is gitignored and root `.gitignore` excludes pack build outputs because runtime pins generated artifacts.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-008 per-project CAS: V1 uses only per-project `<slug>/.cas/<sha256>` storage because shared CAS adds coordination without current need.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-009 code boundary: `code` is deterministic argv, a strict superset of `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}`, may target `artagents executors run <name>`, and must not target `artagents orchestrators run`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-010 nested boundary: Sub-orchestrator delegation is exclusively `nested` so the gate can hash and pin child structure.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-011 gate checks: The gate validates active run presence, plan hash, event chain, and incoming command match before dispatch and prints the exact recovery command on rejection.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-012 gate ordering: The gate runs before `_prepare_project_request()` and `thread_wrapper.begin_orchestrator_run()` so rejected commands create zero project-run side effects.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-013 provenance surface: `events.jsonl` is the single write surface for task-mode provenance while thread provenance remains in `runs/<id>/run.json`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-014 lifecycle dispatch: Task-mode lifecycle verbs extend `artagents/pipeline.py:15` and the existing `artagents orchestrators` CLI remains unchanged.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-015 task kernel namespace: New kernel modules live in `artagents/core/task/` to isolate gate, events, active-run, and env logic from legacy runners.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-016 structure guardrails: `TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS` adds `orchestrate` and `verify`, with `tests/test_doctor_setup.py` updated so doctor accepts the new packages.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-017 task run env: `ARTAGENTS_TASK_RUN_ID` is the integration surface for orchestrator, executor, and hype child calls to attach to the parent task run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-018 child output preservation: Task mode preserves child output dirs and mirrors hype artifacts under `runs/<task-run-id>/steps/<step-id>/produces/` while standalone behavior stays unchanged so `tests/test_project_runs.py` keeps passing.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-019 attestor identity: Agent attestations require `--agent`, human attestations require `--actor` matching `ARTAGENTS_ACTOR`, and self-acks are rejected.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-020 ack rules: `approve` advances, `retry` is only valid after verifier failure, `iterate --feedback` is only valid for `repeat.until=user_approves`, and `abort` ends the run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-021 inline produces checks: Produces inline checks replace verifier substeps while `passes_test` remains a normal `code` step.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-022 semantic checks: `author check` rejects sentinel-only attested outputs because non-trivial artifacts need semantic validation.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-023 stop-hook preamble: Every `artagents next` output includes the prohibition preamble verbatim because repeated injection fights context decay.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-024 additive migration: Existing `OrchestratorDefinition` JSON manifests and `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}` keep working because V1 migration is additive.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-025 honor model: V1 is single-host and honor-based with strong logging because it does not defend against malicious local agents.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-026 cut points: Phase 3 is the frozen-plan runner ship point and Phase 5 is the author-friendly lifecycle ship point.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-027 canonical migration: `artagents/packs/builtin/hype/` is the canonical migration example because it exercises the existing executor pipeline and additive pack layout.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-028 phasing order: V1 implementation follows build phases 1-9 so kernel, step semantics, authoring, lifecycle, nudge, CAS, inbox, and golden tests land in dependency order.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-029 V1 infrastructure limits: V1 excludes daemon, web server, HMAC/keyed crypto, `.index.db`, and shared CAS so the implementation stays file-based, inspectable, and additive.

339	def match_attested_command(incoming: str, expected_prefix: str) -> tuple[bool, AttestedArgs]:
340	    """Strip ``--agent``/``--actor``/``--evidence`` (repeatable) tokens from
341	    ``incoming`` and compare the canonical remainder to ``expected_prefix``.
342	    """
343	    try:
344	        tokens = shlex.split(incoming)
345	    except ValueError:
346	        return False, AttestedArgs(agent=None, actor=None, evidence=())
347	    agent: str | None = None
348	    actor: str | None = None
349	    evidence: list[str] = []
350	    remaining: list[str] = []
351	    i = 0
352	    while i < len(tokens):
353	        token = tokens[i]
354	        if token == "--agent" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
355	            agent = tokens[i + 1]
356	            i += 2
357	            continue
358	        if token == "--actor" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
359	            actor = tokens[i + 1]
360	            i += 2
361	            continue
362	        if token == "--evidence" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
363	            evidence.append(tokens[i + 1])
364	            i += 2
365	            continue
366	        remaining.append(token)
367	        i += 1
368	    rejoined = " ".join(shlex.quote(token) for token in remaining)
369	    matched = rejoined == expected_prefix
370	    return matched, AttestedArgs(agent=agent, actor=actor, evidence=tuple(evidence))
371

  "old_string": "def record_dispatch_complete(decision: GateDecision, returncode: int) -> None:\n    if not decision.active or decision.events_path is None or decision.plan_step_id is None:\n        return\n    if decision.step_kind == \"attested\":\n        # attested steps are advanced by step_attested itself; do not double-emit\n        return\n    append_event(\n        decision.events_path,\n        make_step_completed_event(decision.plan_step_id, returncode),\n    )",
  "new_string": "def record_dispatch_complete(decision: GateDecision, returncode: int) -> None:\n    if not decision.active or decision.events_path is None or decision.plan_step_id is None:\n        return\n    if decision.step_kind == \"attested\":\n        # attested steps are advanced by step_attested itself; do not double-emit\n        return\n    append_event(\n        decision.events_path,\n        make_step_completed_event(decision.plan_step_id, returncode),\n    )\n    if decision.produces:\n        _run_inline_checks(decision, decision.produces)\n\n\n# step_dir_for_path is the ONLY directory API used in this gate path (FLAG-P3-001).\ndef _run_inline_checks(decision: GateDecision, produces: tuple[ProducesEntry, ...]) -> bool:\n    if (\n        decision.events_path is None\n        or decision.run_id is None\n        or decision.slug is None\n        or decision.project_root is None\n        or not decision.plan_step_path\n    ):\n        return True\n    projects_root = decision.project_root.parent\n    step_dir = step_dir_for_path(\n        decision.slug,\n        decision.run_id,\n        decision.plan_step_path,\n        root=projects_root,\n    )\n    for entry in produces:\n        artifact_path = step_dir / entry.path\n        result = entry.check.run(artifact_path)\n        if not result.ok:\n            append_event(\n                decision.events_path,\n                make_produces_check_failed_event(\n                    decision.plan_step_path,\n                    entry.name,\n                    check_id=entry.check.check_id,\n                    reason=result.reason,\n                ),\n            )\n            append_event(\n                decision.events_path,\n                make_cursor_rewind_event(\n                    decision.plan_step_path,\n                    reason=f\"produces check failed: {entry.name}\",\n                ),\n            )\n            return False\n        append_event(\n            decision.events_path,\n            make_produces_check_passed_event(\n                decision.plan_step_path,\n                entry.name,\n                check_id=entry.check.check_id,\n            ),\n        )\n    return True"
}

- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-006 committed DSL: `artagents.orchestrate` Python DSL is the only committed authoring representation so source review happens in Python.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-007 generated build JSON: `<pack>/build/<orch>.json` is gitignored and root `.gitignore` excludes pack build outputs because runtime pins generated artifacts.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-008 per-project CAS: V1 uses only per-project `<slug>/.cas/<sha256>` storage because shared CAS adds coordination without current need.

- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-013 provenance surface: `events.jsonl` is the single write surface for task-mode provenance while thread provenance remains in `runs/<id>/run.json`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-014 lifecycle dispatch: Task-mode lifecycle verbs extend `artagents/pipeline.py:15` and the existing `artagents orchestrators` CLI remains unchanged.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-015 task kernel namespace: New kernel modules live in `artagents/core/task/` to isolate gate, events, active-run, and env logic from legacy runners.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-016 structure guardrails: `TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS` adds `orchestrate` and `verify`, with `tests/test_doctor_setup.py` updated so doctor accepts the new packages.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-017 task run env: `ARTAGENTS_TASK_RUN_ID` is the integration surface for orchestrator, executor, and hype child calls to attach to the parent task run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-018 child output preservation: Task mode preserves child output dirs and mirrors hype artifacts under `runs/<task-run-id>/steps/<step-id>/produces/` while standalone behavior stays unchanged so `tests/test_project_runs.py` keeps passing.

Termination rules: verifier_passes advances on produces_check_passed coverage / treats failures as iteration_failed; user_approves requires attested ack on host (with --actor or --agent), ack consumes iteration frame and advances host; quorum advances after quorum_n distinct attestor_id values across iterations (per A7). For user_approves: when step_attested carries iterate_feedback evidence string, write iterations/NNN/feedback.json (JSON array, append cumulative across iterations); next iteration reads it. CLI verb iterate --feedback ships in Phase 5 \u2014 Phase 3 only exposes the underlying mechanism via direct append_event for tests. When dispatching code inside iteration frame, call apply_task_run_env(..., iteration=N) so subprocess sees ARTAGENTS_TASK_ITERATION=NNN.",

"""Active task-run pointer helpers."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from artagents.core.project.jsonio import read_json, write_json_atomic
from artagents.core.project.paths import project_dir, validate_run_id

_PLAN_HASH_RE = re.compile(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")


class ActiveRunError(ValueError):
    """Raised when active_run.json is malformed."""


def read_active_run(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, str] | None:
    path = _active_run_path(slug, root=root)
    try:
        payload = read_json(path)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    return _validate_active_run(payload)


def write_active_run(
    slug: str,
    *,
    run_id: str,
    plan_hash: str,
    root: str | Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    payload = _validate_active_run({"run_id": run_id, "plan_hash": plan_hash})
    write_json_atomic(_active_run_path(slug, root=root), payload)
    return payload


def clear_active_run(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
    _active_run_path(slug, root=root).unlink(missing_ok=True)


def _active_run_path(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return project_dir(slug, root=root) / "active_run.json"


def _validate_active_run(payload: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ActiveRunError("active_run.json must be an object")
    run_id = payload.get("run_id")
    plan_hash = payload.get("plan_hash")
    if not isinstance(run_id, str):
        raise ActiveRunError("active_run.json run_id must be a string")
    if not isinstance(plan_hash, str) or _PLAN_HASH_RE.fullmatch(plan_hash) is None:
        raise ActiveRunError("active_run.json plan_hash must be sha256:<64 lowercase hex>")
    return {"run_id": validate_run_id(run_id), "plan_hash": plan_hash}
```

104	def derive_cursor(plan: TaskPlan, events: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> CursorPath:
105	    """Replay ``events.jsonl`` left-to-right to reconstruct the path-stack cursor.
106	
107	    Reconstructible from events alone (supports partial-replay resume):
108	    ``nested_entered`` pushes, ``nested_exited`` pops + advances parent,
109	    ``step_completed`` / ``step_attested`` mark a step advance-eligible iff it
110	    has no produces; otherwise advance is deferred until the contiguous block
111	    contains a ``produces_check_passed`` for every declared produces name.
112	    ``produces_check_failed`` / ``cursor_rewind`` clear pending state without
113	    advancing. ``step_dispatched`` / ``run_started`` do not advance.
114	    """
115	    frames: list[_Frame] = [_Frame(plan=plan, path_prefix=(), child_index=0)]
116	    pending: list[set[str] | None] = [None]
117	    for event in events:
118	        kind = event.get("kind")
119	        if kind == "nested_entered":
120	            top = frames[-1]
121	            if top.child_index >= len(top.plan.steps):
122	                raise TaskRunGateError(
123	                    reason="nested_entered points past end of frame",
124	                    recovery="inspect events.jsonl",
125	                )
126	            step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
127	            if not isinstance(step, NestedStep):
128	                raise TaskRunGateError(
129	                    reason="nested_entered did not land on a NestedStep",
130	                    recovery="inspect events.jsonl",
131	                )
132	            frames.append(
133	                _Frame(
134	                    plan=step.plan,
135	                    path_prefix=top.path_prefix + (step.id,),
136	                    child_index=0,
137	                )
138	            )
139	            pending.append(None)
140	        elif kind == "nested_exited":
141	            if len(frames) <= 1:
142	                raise TaskRunGateError(
143	                    reason="nested_exited at root frame",
144	                    recovery="inspect events.jsonl",
145	                )
146	            frames.pop()
147	            pending.pop()
148	            frames[-1].child_index += 1
149	            pending[-1] = None
150	        elif kind in ("step_completed", "step_attested"):
151	            top = frames[-1]
152	            if top.child_index >= len(top.plan.steps):
153	                continue
154	            step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
155	            produces = getattr(step, "produces", ())
156	            if not produces:
157	                top.child_index += 1
158	                pending[-1] = None
159	            else:
160	                pending[-1] = {entry.name for entry in produces}
161	        elif kind == "produces_check_passed":
162	            current = pending[-1]
163	            if current is not None:
164	                name = event.get("produces_name")
165	                current.discard(name)
166	                if not current:
167	                    frames[-1].child_index += 1
168	                    pending[-1] = None
169	        elif kind in ("produces_check_failed", "cursor_rewind"):
170	            pending[-1] = None
171	        elif kind == "step_dispatched":
172	            pending[-1] = None
173	        # run_started: no-op
174	    return CursorPath(frames=frames)

353	def _latest_event_for_step(events: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], path_str: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:

361	            return ev
362	    return None

409	def match_attested_command(incoming: str, expected_prefix: str) -> tuple[bool, AttestedArgs]:
410	    """Strip ``--agent``/``--actor``/``--evidence`` (repeatable) tokens from
411	    ``incoming`` and compare the canonical remainder to ``expected_prefix``.
412	    """
413	    try:
414	        tokens = shlex.split(incoming)
415	    except ValueError:
416	        return False, AttestedArgs(agent=None, actor=None, evidence=())
417	    agent: str | None = None
418	    actor: str | None = None
419	    evidence: list[str] = []
420	    remaining: list[str] = []
421	    i = 0
422	    while i < len(tokens):
423	        token = tokens[i]
424	        if token == "--agent" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
425	            agent = tokens[i + 1]
426	            i += 2
427	            continue
428	        if token == "--actor" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
429	            actor = tokens[i + 1]
430	            i += 2
431	            continue
432	        if token == "--evidence" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
433	            evidence.append(tokens[i + 1])
434	            i += 2
435	            continue
436	        remaining.append(token)
437	        i += 1
438	    rejoined = " ".join(shlex.quote(token) for token in remaining)
439	    matched = rejoined == expected_prefix
440	    return matched, AttestedArgs(agent=agent, actor=actor, evidence=tuple(evidence))
441	
442	
443	def _validate_attested_identity(
444	    *,
445	    slug: str,
446	    step: AttestedStep,
447	    args: AttestedArgs,
448	    run_started_actor: str | None,
449	) -> tuple[str, str]:
450	    if args.agent is None and args.actor is None:
451	        _reject(slug, "attested step requires --agent or --actor", abort=False)
452	    if args.agent is not None and args.actor is not None:
453	        _reject(slug, "attested step rejects both --agent and --actor", abort=False)
454	    if step.ack.kind == "agent":
455	        if args.agent is None:
456	            _reject(slug, "attested step ack.kind=agent requires --agent", abort=False)
457	        return "agent", args.agent  # type: ignore[return-value]
458	    # ack.kind == "actor"
459	    if args.actor is None:
460	        _reject(slug, "attested step ack.kind=actor requires --actor", abort=False)
461	    if task_actor_env() != args.actor:
462	        _reject(slug, "attested --actor does not match ARTAGENTS_ACTOR env", abort=False)
463	    # FLAG-005: self-ack rejection only applies to actor attestations because agents
464	    # do not start runs in V1; an agent_id on run_started would be required to
465	    # symmetrically block agent self-acks, which is out of scope for Phase 2.
466	    if (
467	        run_started_actor is not None
468	        and run_started_actor == args.actor
469	        and task_actor_env() == args.actor
470	    ):
471	        _reject(slug, "self-ack rejected", abort=False)
472	    return "actor", args.actor  # type: ignore[return-value]
473

475	def record_dispatch_complete(decision: GateDecision, returncode: int) -> None:
476	    if not decision.active or decision.events_path is None or decision.plan_step_id is None:
477	        return

514	                    entry.name,
515	                    check_id=entry.check.check_id,

517	                ),
518	            )
519	            append_event(
520	                decision.events_path,
521	                make_cursor_rewind_event(
522	                    decision.plan_step_path,
523	                    reason=f"produces check failed: {entry.name}",
524	                ),
525	            )
526	            return False
527	        append_event(
528	            decision.events_path,
529	            make_produces_check_passed_event(
530	                decision.plan_step_path,
531	                entry.name,
532	                check_id=entry.check.check_id,
533	            ),
534	        )
535	    return True

- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-003 plan naming: Runtime uses immutable `plan.json` instead of checklist naming because the structure is a tree with nested bodies and loops.

- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-006 committed DSL: `artagents.orchestrate` Python DSL is the only committed authoring representation so source review happens in Python.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-007 generated build JSON: `<pack>/build/<orch>.json` is gitignored and root `.gitignore` excludes pack build outputs because runtime pins generated artifacts.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-008 per-project CAS: V1 uses only per-project `<slug>/.cas/<sha256>` storage because shared CAS adds coordination without current need.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-009 code boundary: `code` is deterministic argv, a strict superset of `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}`, may target `artagents executors run <name>`, and must not target `artagents orchestrators run`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-010 nested boundary: Sub-orchestrator delegation is exclusively `nested` so the gate can hash and pin child structure.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-011 gate checks: The gate validates active run presence, plan hash, event chain, and incoming command match before dispatch and prints the exact recovery command on rejection.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-012 gate ordering: The gate runs before `_prepare_project_request()` and `thread_wrapper.begin_orchestrator_run()` so rejected commands create zero project-run side effects.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-013 provenance surface: `events.jsonl` is the single write surface for task-mode provenance while thread provenance remains in `runs/<id>/run.json`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-014 lifecycle dispatch: Task-mode lifecycle verbs extend `artagents/pipeline.py:15` and the existing `artagents orchestrators` CLI remains unchanged.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-015 task kernel namespace: New kernel modules live in `artagents/core/task/` to isolate gate, events, active-run, and env logic from legacy runners.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-016 structure guardrails: `TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS` adds `orchestrate` and `verify`, with `tests/test_doctor_setup.py` updated so doctor accepts the new packages.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-017 task run env: `ARTAGENTS_TASK_RUN_ID` is the integration surface for orchestrator, executor, and hype child calls to attach to the parent task run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-018 child output preservation: Task mode preserves child output dirs and mirrors hype artifacts under `runs/<task-run-id>/steps/<step-id>/produces/` while standalone behavior stays unchanged so `tests/test_project_runs.py` keeps passing.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-019 attestor identity: Agent attestations require `--agent`, human attestations require `--actor` matching `ARTAGENTS_ACTOR`, and self-acks are rejected.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-020 ack rules: `approve` advances, `retry` is only valid after verifier failure, `iterate --feedback` is only valid for `repeat.until=user_approves`, and `abort` ends the run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-021 inline produces checks: Produces inline checks replace verifier substeps while `passes_test` remains a normal `code` step.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-022 semantic checks: `author check` rejects sentinel-only attested outputs because non-trivial artifacts need semantic validation.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-023 stop-hook preamble: Every `artagents next` output includes the prohibition preamble verbatim because repeated injection fights context decay.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-024 additive migration: Existing `OrchestratorDefinition` JSON manifests and `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}` keep working because V1 migration is additive.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-025 honor model: V1 is single-host and honor-based with strong logging because it does not defend against malicious local agents.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-026 cut points: Phase 3 is the frozen-plan runner ship point and Phase 5 is the author-friendly lifecycle ship point.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-027 canonical migration: `artagents/packs/builtin/hype/` is the canonical migration example because it exercises the existing executor pipeline and additive pack layout.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-028 phasing order: V1 implementation follows build phases 1-9 so kernel, step semantics, authoring, lifecycle, nudge, CAS, inbox, and golden tests land in dependency order.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-029 V1 infrastructure limits: V1 excludes daemon, web server, HMAC/keyed crypto, `.index.db`, and shared CAS so the implementation stays file-based, inspectable, and additive.

- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-005 no index database: V1 ships without `.index.db` because file walking and grep over `events.jsonl` are adequate until measured otherwise.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-006 committed DSL: `artagents.orchestrate` Python DSL is the only committed authoring representation so source review happens in Python.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-007 generated build JSON: `<pack>/build/<orch>.json` is gitignored and root `.gitignore` excludes pack build outputs because runtime pins generated artifacts.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-008 per-project CAS: V1 uses only per-project `<slug>/.cas/<sha256>` storage because shared CAS adds coordination without current need.

- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-012 gate ordering: The gate runs before `_prepare_project_request()` and `thread_wrapper.begin_orchestrator_run()` so rejected commands create zero project-run side effects.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-013 provenance surface: `events.jsonl` is the single write surface for task-mode provenance while thread provenance remains in `runs/<id>/run.json`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-014 lifecycle dispatch: Task-mode lifecycle verbs extend `artagents/pipeline.py:15` and the existing `artagents orchestrators` CLI remains unchanged.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-015 task kernel namespace: New kernel modules live in `artagents/core/task/` to isolate gate, events, active-run, and env logic from legacy runners.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-016 structure guardrails: `TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS` adds `orchestrate` and `verify`, with `tests/test_doctor_setup.py` updated so doctor accepts the new packages.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-017 task run env: `ARTAGENTS_TASK_RUN_ID` is the integration surface for orchestrator, executor, and hype child calls to attach to the parent task run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-018 child output preservation: Task mode preserves child output dirs and mirrors hype artifacts under `runs/<task-run-id>/steps/<step-id>/produces/` while standalone behavior stays unchanged so `tests/test_project_runs.py` keeps passing.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-019 attestor identity: Agent attestations require `--agent`, human attestations require `--actor` matching `ARTAGENTS_ACTOR`, and self-acks are rejected.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-020 ack rules: `approve` advances, `retry` is only valid after verifier failure, `iterate --feedback` is only valid for `repeat.until=user_approves`, and `abort` ends the run.

- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-025 honor model: V1 is single-host and honor-based with strong logging because it does not defend against malicious local agents.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-026 cut points: Phase 3 is the frozen-plan runner ship point and Phase 5 is the author-friendly lifecycle ship point.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-027 canonical migration: `artagents/packs/builtin/hype/` is the canonical migration example because it exercises the existing executor pipeline and additive pack layout.

repeat.until(verifier_passes, max=2) wrapping a code with produces.\nslug, run_id = \"demo\", \"r1\"\ncreate_project(slug, root=tmp)\nplan = {\n    \"plan_id\": \"p\", \"version\": 1, \"steps\": [\n        {\n            \"id\": \"first\", \"kind\": \"code\", \"command\": \"echo first\",\n            \"produces\": {\"out\": {\"path\": \"out.json\", \"check\": {\"check_id\": \"json_file\", \"params\": {}, \"sentinel\": False}}},\n        },\n        {\n            \"id\": \"fan\", \"kind\": \"code\", \"command\": \"echo fan\",\n            \"repeat\": {\"for_each\": {\"items\": [\"v1\", \"v2\"]}},\n        },\n        {\n            \"id\": \"loop\", \"kind\": \"code\", \"command\": \"echo loop\",\n            \"produces\": {\"got\": {\"path\": \"got.json\", \"check\": {\"check_id\": \"json_file\", \"params\": {}, \"sentinel\": False}}},\n            \"repeat\": {\"until\": \"verifier_passes\", \"max_iterations\": 2, \"on_exhaust\": \"fail\"},\n        },\n    ],\n}\nplan_path = Path(tmp) / slug / \"plan.json\"\nplan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan), encoding=\"utf-8\")\nwrite_active_run(slug, run_id=run_id, plan_hash=compute_plan_hash(plan_path), root=tmp)\nevents_path = Path(tmp) / slug / \"runs\" / run_id / \"events.jsonl\"\nevents_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n# Step 1: dispatch with garbage → rewind, redispatch with valid JSON → advance.\nd1a = task_gate.gate_command(slug, \"echo first\", [\"echo\",\"first\"], root=tmp)\nsd1 = step_dir_for_path(slug, run_id, (\"first\",), root=tmp); sd1.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n(sd1 / \"out.json\").write_text(\"garbage\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\ntask_gate.record_dispatch_complete(d1a, 0)\nkinds_after_fail = [e[\"kind\"] for e in read_events(events_path)]\nassert kinds_after_fail[-2:] == [\"produces_check_failed\", \"cursor_rewind\"], kinds_after_fail\n\nd1b = task_gate.gate_command(slug, \"echo first\", [\"echo\",\"first\"], root=tmp)\n(sd1 / \"out.json\").write_text('{\"ok\":1}', encoding=\"utf-8\")\ntask_gate.record_dispatch_complete(d1b, 0)\nassert read_events(events_path)[-1][\"kind\"] == \"produces_check_passed\"\n\n# Step 2: for_each items=['v1','v2']\ndf1 = make_item_completed_event(df1.plan_step_path, \"v1\", 0))\n\ndf2 = task_gate.gate_command(slug, \"echo fan\", [\"echo\",\"fan\"], root=tmp)\nassert df2.item_id == \"v2\",
